claim.verdict: ROBUST within the seven finite native profiles and tested guard boundaries
claim.producer: Root independently reviewed source/diff and executed serialized gates. Same-lineage delegated reviews are correlated support, not independent model agreement.

boundaries.overall_goal: ACTIVE: legal CH-compatible read/write types and MV/projections before memory/performance; not full-goal or <=10% slowdown closure.
boundaries.composition: One closed nominal Geometry storage owner; reuse existing Custom/Variant/Geo and ordinary wrapper visitors, physical plans, census and staged publisher. No per-product serde.
boundaries.nominal_descriptor: 0x2c, VarUInt 8, Geometry; hidden fixed-order Variant roster is not separately serialized.
boundaries.finite_part_profile: Quiescent Wide/LZ4/Default/BASIC/plain-mrk2; sorted UInt64 key and one payload. Bare Geometry has ten rows, five data marks [2,2,2,2,2], plus native terminal mark. Six wrappers have five rows, three data marks [2,2,1], plus terminal. Writer nested String version 1 and frame_bytes 4096.
boundaries.consumer_boundary: Direct bulk and independently checked stock/generated reads cover seven profiles. Six recursive forms have public typed full/window/EOF consumers. Bare Geometry preserves native-tested legacy GeometryRow coordinate/topology contracts; owned offline values also have local coverage.
guards: Direct Nullable(Geometry), direct Variant(Geometry, String), and LowCardinality(Geometry) are actual native refusals.

Extracted fixed-order storage marker rejected by ordinary immediate-child/declaration and public descriptor/scalar/facade/raw bulk wire roots; internal nominal traversal and non-wire planning/default introspection remain available.
Arbitrary Custom names, JSON/Dynamic/LowCardinality/QBit/SAF/AF intersections, Geo Map keys and unqualified physical versions are not qualified by this slice.
No Compact/sparse/new physical versions, general multi-column publication, projection/MV execution/writing or live freshness qualification.
boundaries.resource_boundary: Original shared budgets/depth account hidden expansion, codec, transport and result work. Structural census precedes first/EOF callbacks. No full-column cache or allocator/throughput change.
boundaries.residual_resource_risk: Per-mark transport re-resolves/reindexes paired streams and can repeat cross-mark frame decoding, conservatively exhausting consumptive budgets on large parts.
boundaries.evidence_boundary: Actual sidecars, captured output and file-copy consistency are checked, not immutable cryptographic execution provenance. Coordinated alteration of every raw/generated/attached/snapshot copy and witness can evade an auditor without an independent immutable anchor.

source.source_scope: separately fetched DataTypes/serialization source snapshot; not runtime provenance
